The '''Montoro serving drone''' was a [[Service droid/Legends|service droid]] in use in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] as of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The body of the drone was yellow, and the droid rode on two wheels.

The body of the droid was salvaged to be used on another droid.
